comparison.objective: Dose loose granules into a tared weighing boat until an analytical balance reads 1.00 g.
comparison.physical_skill: Door operation, container placement, tare sequencing, incremental pouring, and feedback-based dosing.
comparison.success_condition: Correct empty-boat tare, boat present, final mass near 1.00 g, shield closed, and little or no spill.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate multiple loose bodies, but PR-621 transfers all target granules by pouring to a mass reading. The candidate physically separates two intermixed populations by aperture size while retaining washers and reseating the screen—an additional and different tested ability.
